programme.title: Solaris
programme.desc: A psychologist is sent to a station orbiting a distant planet in order to discover what has caused the crew to go insane.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Veronica and mysterious new kid give teen angst a body count.

programme.title: Donnie Darko
programme.desc: After escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit

programme.title: House (1977)
programme.desc: A schoolgirl and six of her classmates travel to her aunt's country home, which turns out to be haunted.

programme.title: The Brood
programme.desc: A man tries to uncover an unconventional psychologist's therapy techniques on his institutionalized wife, amidst a series of brutal murders.

programme.title: Eraserhead
programme.desc: Surreal nightmare about a man, his mutant child, and industrial decay.

programme.title: Buena Vista Social Club
programme.desc: Aging Cuban musicians whose talents had been virtually forgotten following Castro's takeover of Cuba, are brought out of retirement by Ry Cooder, who travelled to Havana in order to bring the musicians together, resulting in triumphant performances of extraordinary music, and resurrecting the musicians' careers.

programme.title: The Harder They Come
programme.desc: Wishing to become a successful reggae singer, a young Jamaican man finds himself tied to corrupt record producers and drug pushers.

programme.title: Going All The Way
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman and "Sonny" Burns reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy and tempting Gale Ann. As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Metroland
programme.desc: In late-1970s suburban London, Chris and Marion have settled into a comfortable yet all-too-predictable middle-class existence. Chris receives an unexpected visit from his free-spirited friend Toni, a reunion that reminds him of a more carefree time in 1960s Paris. Now, with lingering doubts about his marriage bubbling up, Chris must make the choice between revisiting his youthful abandon with Toni or facing the here and now with Marion.

programme.title: Her Smell
programme.desc: A self-destructive punk rocker struggles with sobriety while trying to recapture the creative inspiration that led her band to success.

programme.title: The Reality of Love
programme.desc: The manager of sinking idol Ryan Banks attempts to revive his career by making him the star of a reality show where contestants get the chance to be his bride. Starring Jason Priestley ("Beverly Hills, 90210") and Bradley Cooper (A Star Is Born).

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: A troubled young woman is sent to live with her grandmother for the summer, while hiding a secret that could potentially tear her family apart.

programme.title: Marshall
programme.desc: Thurgood Marshall, the first African-American Supreme Court Justice, battles through one of his career-defining cases.

programme.title: Tie Me Up! Tie Me Down!
programme.desc: An unbalanced but alluring former mental patient takes a porn star prisoner in the hopes of convincing her to marry him.

programme.title: Intimacy
programme.desc: She comes to his place, late every Wednesday afternoon, only for sex, while her taxi waits outside. The don't speak but something must pass between them because they stand together and lie down next to the table, without a word...

programme.title: The Loft
programme.desc: Five men share a loft for affairs; a woman’s body changes everything.

programme.title: Stay Cool
programme.desc: A successful author is forced to confront an unrequited high school crush when he returns home to deliver a commencement address to graduating seniors. Shasta O'Neil, a sexy high school senior flirts with the visiting author and invites him to the prom.

programme.title: Watership Down
programme.desc: Hoping to escape destruction by human developers and save their community, a colony of rabbits, led by Hazel and Fiver, seek out a safe place to set up a new warren.

programme.title: Lonely Hearts
programme.desc: Based on the true story, two homicide detectives track Martha Beck and Raymond Martinez Fernandez, a murderous pair known as the "Lonely Hearts Killers" who lured their victims through the personals.

programme.title: Dead Man
programme.desc: On the run after murdering a man, accountant William Blake encounters a strange Native American man named Nobody who prepares him for his journey into the spiritual world.

programme.title: Chasing Sleep
programme.desc: Ed Saxon has been married for the past twenty years with barely a hitch, but tonight his wife has not returned home. After a restless night, he decides to call the police at dawn and alert them of her possible disappearance. An investigation gets underway revealing some unsettling news for Ed. He begins to learn how unhappy his wife has been with him. Perhaps he preferred to ignore the glaring reality. For inspector Derm, his wife's lover is number one on his suspect list. But he's not the only one. Each new visitor becomes a suspect in Ed's eyes. One of them is the strange psychiatrist who claims to have come to help Ed overcome the pain. And now that Eve is absent, her presence has never been so resonant in the house.

programme.title: Limitless
programme.desc: A mysterious pill that enables the user to access 100% of his brain's abilities transforms a struggling writer into a financial wizard, but it also puts him in a new world with many dangers.

programme.title: The Marksman
programme.desc: A rancher on the Arizona border becomes the unlikely defender of a young Mexican boy desperately fleeing the cartel assassins who've pursued him into the U.S.

programme.title: Arlington Road
programme.desc: Man begins to suspect his neighbors are not what they appear to be and their secrets could be deadly

programme.title: The Exorcist III
programme.desc: A chilling sequel to the horror classic.

programme.title: The Stuff
programme.desc: When a mysterious goo oozes from the earth, it's marketed as the newest dessert sensation. A private detective investigates the sweet treat that's absolutely delicious...and possibly lethal.

programme.title: Irresistible
programme.desc: A wife and mother is consumed by the thought that her husband's co-worker is trying to win him away from her and their family.

programme.title: Coffee And Cigarettes
programme.desc: A series of vignettes that all have coffee and cigarettes in common.

programme.title: The Umbrellas Of Cherbourg
programme.desc: A young woman separated from her lover by war faces a life-altering decision.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Chan Wing Yan, a young police officer, has been sent undercover as a mole in the local mafia. Lau Kin Ming, a young mafia member, infiltrates the police force. Years later, their older counterparts, Chen Wing Yan and Inspector Lau Kin Ming, respectively, race against time to expose the mole within their midst.

programme.title: Paris, Texas
programme.desc: Travis Henderson, an aimless drifter who has been missing for four years, wanders out of the desert and must reconnect with society, himself, his life, and his family.

programme.title: Funny Games
programme.desc: Two violent young men take a mother, father, and son hostage in their vacation cabin and force them to play sadistic "games" with one another for their own amusement.

programme.title: Woodworkers Guild of America presented by CraftsyTV
programme.desc: In the episode "Easy Projects with Native Materials," the focus is on crafting robust furniture using natural materials, bringing joy to woodworking enthusiasts. The project kicks off with a stool build using one-inch dowels for rails and sturdy legs crafted from one-and-a-half-inch square pieces. A standout feature is the woven seat, initially demonstrated with bundling twine but showcased with Cecil rope for its natural charm and durability. The construction process begins meticulously, drilling precise holes using a drill press for consistent alignment. Offset holes on adjacent faces accommodate the rails snugly, while chamfered ends prevent any interference during assembly. Dry-fitting ensures all components fit seamlessly before applying glue, guaranteeing a sturdy final product. After assembly, the stool is clamped securely to maintain square alignment and left to dry before sanding and finishing bring out the wood's natural beauty. The seat weaving process is a highlight, with the speaker demonstrating how to wrap Cecil rope around the frame in a precise pattern, creating a durable and visually appealing seat. Throughout, the importance of precision and the handy use of pliers for control during weaving are emphasized. The episode also explores comparisons between stools made from different materials, celebrating the diversity of woodworking choices. Transitioning to a coffee table project, the speaker selects wood pieces with a striking blue stain for added visual interest. Techniques for drilling and joint fitting are expertly demonstrated, ensuring the table frame is not just sturdy but also artistically crafted. Challenges encountered, such as uneven surfaces or knots in the tabletop, are met with practical solutions, including finishing tips with Danish oil for a natural, lustrous look. Throughout the tutorial, the joy of working with native materials and the satisfaction of creating beautiful, enduring furniture pieces shine through, making it a delightful watch for woodworking enthusiasts of all skill levels.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: In the first challenge, the teams must produce 36 perfect prinsesstårta alongside a chocolate amenity and no recipes to follow. In the second challenge, the teams must transform a British classic, bread and butter pudding, complete with towering edible showpiece sculptures, all in 5 hours.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: In the first challenge, the teams are tasked with creating 24 completely reimagined millefeuille and 24 pavlovas served in ways never before seen. In the second challenge the teams must create a showpiece display, featuring two batches of 24 identical modern religieuse modelled on musical icons

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The remaining teams must present 24 fruity chocolate desserts alongside 24 chocolate desserts celebrating all the delights of Autumn. For the showpiece challenge, each team must present 48 chocolate bars within a Safari themed chocolate showpiece, featuring a moving part all in just five hours

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The final six must create a plated dessert for each of the judges, which celebrates herbs and spices with just the ingredients laid before them. The teams face a second challenge to create a hanging showpiece adorned with petit fours with the theme Take Flight in just five and half hours.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The five teams create 24 savoury puff pastries alongside three sharing-sized brioche feuilletée. In the second challenge they have five hours to create 30 individual desserts, within an incredible showpiece combining both sugar and chocolate work, with A Life of Amphibians and Reptiles themes

programme.title: Celebrity Baking Show
programme.desc: Matt Lucas is joined by MC Dizzee Rascal, radio DJ Nick Grimshaw, psychiatrist and author Phillipa Perry and comedian Reece Shearsmith. They’re baking to inspire viewers to do the same, and to raise money for charity.

programme.title: Celebrity Baking Show
programme.desc: In this episode of Celebrity Baking Show Matt Lucas invites four more celebrities into the tent to showcase their baking skills for charity. They are journalist and presenter Stacey Dooley, Little Mix's Jade Thirlwall, internet personality KSI and comedian Katherine Ryan.

programme.title: Celebrity Baking Show
programme.desc: In the fifth and final episode Lucas welcomes TV presenter Anneka Rice, comedian John Bishop, popstar Nadine Coyle and sportsman and TV presenter Ade Adepitan into the tent. Only one of the celebrity bakers can claim the winner’s apron but they all have the chance to raise money for charity.

programme.title: Celebrity Baking Show
programme.desc: Emma Willis, Clara Amfo, Blake Harrison and Alex Horne take on decorated biscuits, madeleines and a showstopping choux sculpture that embodies their secret talent. The celebs will have to pull out all the stops to claim the Star Baker apron

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The teams take on renowned pastry chef Philip Khoury's signature Dawn of a New Day dessert, a plant based masterpiece. For their second challenge, the teams have five hours to create a miniature village scene inspired by the, Land of the Giants made with bûche entremet for 40 guests.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The remaining three teams pour all their patisserie passion into two final challenges. They step into the 1920s and create delicious sharing deserts - a chiffon pie, a decadent jelly and a baked Alaska. The final seven-hour challenge sees each team create a 1920s Banquet display to feed 80 people.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: To kick things off the teams must rely on their patisserie instincts, knowledge and teamwork to create 36 individual tarte aux fraise and one chocolate amenity in just three and a half hours. The second, challenges the teams to a music themed Trompe L’oeil showpiece with hidden Pecan Pies

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The teams must turn all their patisserie experience to create 24 identical reimagined custard tarts and 24 cotton cheesecakes. In their second challenge the teams will have five hours to turn the spectacle of Carnival into showpiece structures adorned with exotic flavoured desserts.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: In their first challenge, the teams must turn their hand to viennoiserie as they are tasked to make 18 cross laminated pain suisse and 24 savoury brioche doughnuts. For their showpiece challenge, the teams produce choux showpieces featuring 160 individual choux buns inspired by the theme, Circus

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The judges have a secret challenge in store for the teams, the coffee éclair, with no recipe and just three and a half hours to complete the task. In their second challenge, the teams will have five hours to create a Trompe L’oeil showpiece sculpture inspired by everyday household objects.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The search for Britain’s best pastry chef races on with hosts Ellie Taylor and Liam Charles. The five remaining teams undertake two even tougher challenges to create 4 charlotte a la russe, and Haute Couture inspired Showpieces with aperitif flavoured desserts in just five hours

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The remaining 4 teams are fighting it out under the sharp gaze from patisserie experts Benoit Blin and Cherish Finden. The teams must deliver 18 savoury croissants and 24 perfectly filled maritozzi, and tap into their playful side as they produce towerling choux and nougatine showpieces.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The competition is about to get even tougher for the teams as the search for Britain’s best pastry chefs continues into the Final Six. The best three teams from each set of heats come together in this chocolate fuelled episode as they continue in their pursuit to reach the final.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: It’s the quarter finals, and the five remaining teams create a plated dessert for each of the judges, which celebrates caramel. For their second challenge, the teams will have 5 hours to create a display of frozen lollipops, within a delicate sugar sculpture inspired by the theme Winter Wonderland.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The semi-final and if the four remaining teams thought it had been tough so far then they are going to need to brace themselves for what’s in store. World renowned sugar expert and guest judge Nicolas Houchet, Executive Pastry Chef at the iconic 5-star hotel, The Savoy, will set their first challenge.

programme.title: Baking Show The Professionals
programme.desc: The search for Britain’s best pastry chefs reaches its conclusion in the grand finale. The remaining three teams pour all their patisserie passion and expertise into two epic final challenges, where nothing less than brilliance will be good enough at this stage of the competition.

programme.title: Paul Hollywood: A Bakers Life
programme.desc: Paul Hollywood reflects on his time on The Great British Baking Show, watching footage of his original audition tapes, and providing a never before seen behind the scenes look at the famous tent. Paul opens up his personal cook book to recreate some personal favourites from a lifetime of baking.

programme.title: Paul Hollywood: A Bakers Life
programme.desc: Paul Hollywood goes back to his roots in Merseyside to reminisce about where his love of baking began, visiting his mum to recreate – her legendary Ginger Biscuits. Paul takes us to the church he grew up a part of and reflects on his school days with younger brother and Headteacher Jason.

programme.title: Paul Hollywood: A Bakers Life
programme.desc: Paul Hollywood returns home to Merseyside to meet up with his oldest and closest friends who share insights into Paul in his teens and early twenties.. Paul shares favourite recipes from a lifetime of baking including miniature Fresh Fruit Doughnuts and a scone ring he once made for the Queen Mother

programme.title: Paul Hollywood: A Bakers Life
programme.desc: Paul Hollywood returns to Cyprus and shares his favourite Mediterranean recipes from the island where he spent several years working and where he met his wife Alex. Paul recalls his first appearance on television and recreates a Cypriot Village Bread –first used on screen 20 years ago.

programme.title: Paul Hollywood Bread
programme.desc: In this first programme, Paul explains the basics of bread making by making a classic white bloomer and bakes his ultimate ploughman's loaf. For tea there’s Paul’s fruit-packed malt loaf and for a hearty dinner Paul shares his recipe for a flat loaf piled high with lamb steaks and salad.

programme.title: Paul Hollywood Bread
programme.desc: Paul Hollywood and takes viewers on a globetrotting journey into the diverse and colourful world of flat breads. Along the way, he serves up flavour-packed dishes from all over the world, delicious at any time of day.

programme.title: Paul Hollywood Bread
programme.desc: This episode is all about revealing the secrets of some of the most iconic breads from the continent and using them to make delicious, colourful and irresistible dishes. Paul demonstrates how to bake baguettes, crusty ciabatta loaves and the perfect pizza base.

programme.title: Paul Hollywood Bread
programme.desc: Sourdough is the ultimate bread for flavour and texture. If you're passionate about bread making then you've got to try making your own. Paul shows you how to cultivate your own sourdough starter, harnessing natural, airborne yeasts to leaven and give amazing flavour to your breads.

programme.title: Paul Hollywood Bread
programme.desc: If you would love to have a go at bread making but are put off by all the kneading, proving and waiting, soda bread is the bread for you. Paul Hollywood shows breads you can make from start to finish in under an hour. No kneading, no proving - just mix, shape and bake.

programme.title: Paul Hollywood Bread
programme.desc: Paul shows how enriched breads can be a spectacular treat that deserve their place at the heart of any celebration meal. Paul shares the secrets of Danish pastries, teaches a local baking club the classic lardy cake recipe and demonstrates how to create a stunning savoury brioche crown.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The ten bakers tackle three challenges as their cake making ability is tested. They start with their signature bake - the cake they love that says something about them. Next, is the technical challenge - a blind recipe for Victoria sandwich. Finally, they tackle a chocolate showstopper.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: As the bakers battle it out over biscuits, scones and petit fours, Mel and Sue find out how the digestive became Britain's favourite biscuit, ask what's so Scottish about shortbread and discover why Sir Ranulph Fiennes has the world's most expensive biscuit.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It's week three and the six remaining bakers are making bread in Kent. And as they battle it out to produce the perfect loaf, Mel and Sue will be tasting Britain's earliest bread roll, finding out what happened to break during the Industrial Revolution and relating the hidden history of the sandwich

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It's week four and the remaining five bakers travel to Bakewell in Derbyshire. They must reinvent a British classic - the pudding. There are sticky toffee puddings, peach and blueberry 'boy bait', rhubarb and orange betty and a cherry queen of puddings. Can the bakers rise to the occasion?

programme.title: Celebrity Baking Show
programme.desc: Ruby Wax, Gareth Malone, Laura Whitmore and Yung Filly take on Signature fruit turnovers, a chocolate fondant Technical and relive embarrassing moments in a meringue Showstopper

programme.title: Celebrity Baking Show
programme.desc: Baking Show's very own Matt Lucas joins Annie Mac, Ed Gamble and Example as they make Signature stained-glass biscuits and showstopping cakes that depict what they did before they were famous

programme.title: Celebrity Baking Show
programme.desc: Mo Farah, Motsi Mabuse, Katherine Kelly and Ben Miller tackle meringue roulades and traditional Italian biscuits, and render their favourite childhood memory in cake form in the Showstopper

programme.title: Celebrity Baking Show
programme.desc: Ellie Goulding, Mawaan Rizwan, Sophie Morgan and Tracey-Ann Oberman make marble cake, jam roly-poly and biscuit portraits of their own celebrity heroes.These celebs are baking for charity and to win the covetable Star Baker apron.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It's the penultimate round and the bakers are in the Cornish village of Mousehole, to get to grips with the most difficult of all baking skills - pastry. They make their own version of hearty British pies, produce pastry canapes, and take a crash-course in crimping for this week's surprise bake.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: It's the grand final and the three surviving contestants face their biggest challenge yet - baking for an afternoon tea party. to be crowned the victor they need to bring together their skills making cakes, bread and pastry. Mel and Sue can only present the trophy to one. Wil will it be?

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: Catching up with the bakers to hear the highs and lows of their journey, we learn where they are now and how The Great British Baking Show changed their lives. With contributions from judges Mary Berry and Paul Hollywood, who give their own accounts and memories from the series.

programme.title: The Great British Baking Show
programme.desc: The twelve amateur bakers are challenged to make 24 beautifully flavoured and decorated cupcakes, to make a coffee and walnut Battenberg cake from one of Mary Berry’s recipes and finally they have to make and bake a tiered showstopper cake.

programme.desc: Jamie hacks his oven into a rotisserie for crispy chicken and chips and bakes a savory spinach and feta pie. Then, the Godfather of Spanish cuisine, Jose Pizarro, shares some gorgeous Mediterranean flavours using just 5 everyday ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Jamie raids his pantry for a speedy veggie carbonara and rice pudding popsicles.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Jamie turns frozen fish and veggies into a time saving supper. Then, Italian chef, Gennaro Contaldo rustles up some delicious homemade gnocchi using just 5 easy ingredients.

programme.title: Jamie Oliver's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: Jamie's dressing a salad with a crown of cheese! He's also got a speedy twist on Sunday roast chicken and an elegant apple tart all with 5 fabulous ingredients.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered S1 - "Cold War In Central America"
programme.desc: In the 1980s, El Salvador and Nicaragua were fighting vicious civil wars that claimed killed at least 100,000, saw 8000 people disappear, and left hundreds of thousands displaced. Still spearheading a global fight against communism, the US engaged.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs"
programme.desc: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. Using the latest technology, bits of plastic and a block of aluminum will be melted, molded, and cut to create a snap-on weapon that increases the firepower in a soldier’s hands by a long shot.

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
programme.desc: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .

programme.title: Battle Factory S1 - "An F16, a Sword, and Simulated Ammunition"
programme.desc: Brainpower and firepower transform 8,000 kilograms of computer-controlled machinery into a legendary dogfighter with the best fight and flight record in the sky; the Lockheed Martin F16.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Army Combatives"
programme.desc: At Fort Benning’s Army Combatives School, soldiers train in brutal hand-to-hand combat, learning real-world skills to fight and survive.

programme.title: Combat Forces S1 - "Stealth Submarines"
programme.desc: Stealthy diesel submarines challenge nuclear subs. Inside a NATO exercise, we explore why they’re so deadly in the Norwegian fjords.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies"
programme.desc: At the Wensleydale Creamery, Lord Prescott joins master cheesemakers to follow the production of the famous Yorkshire Wensleydale cheese, learning the art of cheese-tasting along the way. His next stop is Mowbray Pork Pies, where he experiences the high-speed world of pie production.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Lea and Perrins Worcestershire Sauce and Soreen's Malt Loaf"
programme.desc: Exploring the historic Lea & Perrins factory, Lord Prescott uncovers the story behind its legendary Worcestershire sauce, made since 1837. He then heads to Manchester to the Soreen factory, home of the beloved malt loaf, where he joins the production line and experiments with creating a new flavour.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Ambrosia's desserts and Young's battered fish"
programme.desc: To discover how his favourite meal—fish supper followed by rice pudding—is made, Lord Prescott visits the Ambrosia factory in Devon to explore the production of classic British desserts. Returning north to Grimsby, he heads to the Young's factory to learn about their famous fish pie.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Day or Night"
programme.desc: Dave handles a college AC unit and a historic ride, Brad and Nathan battle wind lifting trusses, and Dan and Francis work the night shift underground.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Ticket to Ride"
programme.desc: Brad and Nathan build a fire training unit, Dave works on amusement rides, and Dan and Francis lift a massive excavator from a construction pit.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Look Who’s Lifting Now"
programme.desc: Apprentice Eden tackles her first big lift. Dan and Francis work a hydro dam, Brad and Nathan assemble a gantry, and J.P. moves steel beams.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Just Like Downtown"
programme.desc: Dave deals with a messy train, J.P. takes down a tree, Regional Crane lifts a huge wall, and Maxum Crane moves a couch to a high-rise.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Venice"
programme.desc: CGI strips the marble from Saint Mark’s and peels back the canals to reveal the 400-year-old foundations keeping sinking Venice afloat.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Chicago"
programme.desc: CGI strips Chicago’s Willis Tower and L-rail to reveal how green roofs, deep tunnels, and heat-proofed bridges protect 10 million citizens.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Machu Picchu"
programme.desc: Stripping away the granite, CGI reveals the quake-proof walls and hidden canals that allowed Machu Picchu to survive at 11,000 feet.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Stripping Los Angeles to its core, CGI reveals the hidden steel and fault lines that help this earthquake-prone city survive "the Big One."

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Ceausescu's Delusions of Grandeur"

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "The Best Of"
programme.desc: Travel across the continent, exploring the opulent villas, luxurious palaces, remote command centers, underground tunnels, and secret bunkers of Europe’s most tyrannical dictators.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hitler's Last Secret"
programme.desc: Thanks to secret, recently discovered microfilm, Hitler's last secret is revealed: a sprawling underground headquarters at Książ Castle.

programme.title: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Mussolini's Underground Refuge"
programme.desc: 50 km north of Rome lies the greatest hideout in fascist Italy’s history: The Monte Soratte Bunker, with security features even a Bond villain could only dream of.

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "River Rescue"

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Minnesota Family Farmhouse"

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Million Dollar Mansion"

programme.title: Massive Moves S1 - "Hawaii House Chop"

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Private pilot emergency"

programme.desc: An insight into how used aluminium cans are turned into planes and rockets, and the carving of a traditional Black Forest cuckoo clock.

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Mardi Gras, Rock Candy, Dentures"
programme.desc: A look at how the amazing, and massive, decorations on Mardi Gras carnival floats are created, how rock candy is twisted together, and a look at how dentures are made.

programme.title: How Do They Do It S14 - "Helmets, Tea, District Heating"
programme.desc: How do they harvest and treat the world's most expensive tea? Plus, how does the Siekierki power plant of Warsaw, Poland heat half the city's homes?

programme.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Food"

programme.title: The Chain: How The World Works S1 - "Transport"
programme.desc: At a Formula-E race in Chile, we uncover how tree sap, pink lithium lakes, molten rock, and top-secret paint create cutting-edge electric cars.

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "A Taste of Life Part 1"

programme.title: Health Explored S2 - "Adaptation"
programme.desc: Travel to La Paz, Bolivia, to see how high altitude impacts the body. From science to tradition, visit the witches market and learn about an ancient Inca medicine for altitude sickness

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Threatened Places"
programme.desc: In this episode, we visit a few examples of threatened places.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S5 - "Hidden Nature"
programme.desc: In this episode, we see a few hidden parts of nature.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Asteroids"

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Black Holes"
programme.desc: Stripping away cosmic layers with CGI, this film reveals how black holes act as both destructive abysses and vital anchors for our galaxy.

programme.desc: How do they engineer the latest incarnation of the classic Royal Enfield Continental GT motorbike? Plus, how do 'art detectives' spot a forgery?

programme.desc: Television towers are a distinctive type of structure that have long transcended the utilitarian purpose they were designed for.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Stadiums: Stunning Arenas"
programme.desc: Sports stadiums are widely considered architectural treasures, on par with shrines, cathedrals and other important monuments.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "Memorials and Monuments: Built in Honor"
programme.desc: Monuments like the Great Sphinx, Hagia Sophia and Statue of Liberty are valued for their historical, religious and national significance.

programme.title: Top 10: The Art of Architecture S1 - "City Squares: Amazing and Never Still"
programme.desc: City squares have distinctive characters and often play a major role in enriching and enhancing the cultures of their cities.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Combat Helicopters"
programme.desc: Ultimate Combat Helicopters offers a fascinating perspective on the technology used to create today’s most powerful combat helicopters.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Thrill Rides"
programme.desc: Explore the ultimate adrenaline rush – the world’s fastest and scariest thrill rides.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Explosions"
programme.desc: Ultimate Explosions chronicles the compelling stories of explosions that have reverberated around the world.

programme.title: The Ultimates S1 - "Ultimate Racing Crashes"
programme.desc: Explore the high tech, high-speed world of car and bike racing.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Super Spider Silk"
programme.desc: From their unique predatory behaviors to the web masterpieces they weave, science is revealing big breakthroughs about spiders and their super strong and flexible silks.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Secrets of a Dog's Nose"
programme.desc: A dog's sense of smell can do amazing things. Dog can help humans sniff out all kinds of things that improve our lives, explosives, missing persons, illegal drugs. Now the latest research is revealing that dogs can detect disease, even cancer.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "ICARUS: Tracking Creatures From Space"
programme.desc: The ICARUS system monitors the movements and behaviors of Earth's creatures from space.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Voyage to Venus"
programme.desc: For the first time in decades, NASA is sending two new missions to Venus designed to study and explore the planet's atmosphere and earth-like composition.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Iberian Lynx: Saving the World's Most Endangered Cat"
programme.desc: The Iberian Lynx, classified as the world's most endangered cat, was once close to total extinction. Now, a group of scientists and conservationists are battling to repopulate the species, giving hope that these elusive animals may one day comeback.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Women with ADHD"
programme.desc: For decades, it was thought that ADHD primarily affected boys and men. Bue new research is revealing the stunning impact the disorder can have on women, leading to effective treatments for millions who may be suffering in silence.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Apocalypse 101"
programme.desc: Could you find a way to survive in a post-apocalyptic world? Astrobiologist and author Lewis Dartnell explores what it would take to stay alive following a global cataclysm, and what knowledge we would need to rebuild civilization as we know it.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Alien in the Pond"
programme.desc: An alien world of bizzare creatures exists in the surface film of most lakes and ponds - tiny insects, with incredible capabilities, locked in a life and death struggle to survive.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S1 - "Solar"
programme.desc: The sun is the biggest source of energy in the solar system. Innovators are searching for new ways to capture more of the sun's power.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "Electric Vehicles"
programme.desc: This film follows the emerging world of Electric Vehicles, the infrastructure needed for them, and the radical change we must make to the way we think about transport.

programme.title: Engineering the Future S2 - "The Metaverse"
programme.desc: This episode is different, it's about an idea, the Metaverse. The Metaverse is the successor to the internet. It will change the lives of almost every human on the planet.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Arming Space Force"
programme.desc: In this episode, we explore all the ways in which wars in space might be fought and who stands to make a pretty penny developing space-age weaponry.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Above The Law"
programme.desc: Who decides the law in space? And how will it be enforced?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Toxic Space Factories"
programme.desc: Will it ever make sense to use outer space to offshore human pollution and waste?

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Suing Our Way To Space"
programme.desc: Cowboy hat-wearing billionaires have reasons for their multi-billion dollar investment in space exploration but it’s hard to ignore how much money they stand to make.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "The Astronauts"
programme.desc: One hundred kilometres above the Earth’s surface lies an invisible frontier: the edge of space. This is the Karman Line, the boundary between our planet’s atmosphere and what lies beyond. What does it take to cross that line?

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Getting There"
programme.desc: Launching payloads into space is a very difficult task, historically rocket launches are the proverbial 'swords into ploughshares' Missiles designed to carry atomic warheads now send satellites and probes into the solar system.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Orbit"
programme.desc: The International Space Station is undoubtedly the jewel in the crown of low Earth orbit; observation post, research lab and class room. Equally however there are many other assets orbiting Earth that are even more important to our everyday lives.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Shore to Shore"
programme.desc: Our seafaring nature has translated well to the space age, seeking to sail out into the unknown in search of riches of one kind or another. While Europe and Asia continue their interest in the resource rich Moon, The United States and NASA on Mars.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Comets"
programme.desc: Peeling back the dusty coma via CGI, this film explores if icy comets brought water and life to Earth while tracking the threats they pose.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Will Satellites Help Us Save or Exploit Earth?"
programme.desc: Our long-term survival on this planet depends on advanced satellites keeping us connected and keeping an eye on the Earth from orbit.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Space Pirates"
programme.desc: Between advanced satellites and tons of precious resources the future of space exploration looks to be highly profitable.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Mad Scientists In Outer Space"
programme.desc: The unique properties of space make it ideal for some world-changing and unique scientific experiments.

programme.title: Space Greed S1 - "Space As A Tax Haven"
programme.desc: For the ultra-wealthy, the best part of making money is avoiding taxes. Space could be an astronomical payday, but will all that profit slip by tax free?

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Mars: Adapt or Leave"
programme.desc: As the latest successes and failures come and go Mars continues to give up her secrets. Invisible clouds are revealed with ultraviolet light and the search for the source of methane continues with ExoMars.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Emissaries"
programme.desc: Our solar system is vast, from our own star the Sun to Earth is nearly 150 million kilometers or 1 Astronomical Unit. Jupiter is 5.2 AU distant and Pluto up to 48AU, the solar system extends far beyond this into interstellar space.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "Danger Asteroids Ahead"
programme.desc: The question often rises is the cost of space exploration really worth it? Could the money be better spent elsewhere. If so one space program would have to remain. The planetary defence program, to locate identify and deflect a wayward asteroid.

programme.title: The New Frontier S2 - "First Light"
programme.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther – carrying us ever closer to the first light.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Mars"
programme.desc: Beneath the red dust, CGI peels away Martian volcanoes and ice to reveal a once-Earth-like world and the challenges of future human missions.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "The Sun"
programme.desc: By stripping away the Sun's boiling plasma layers, this CGI study reveals the nuclear core that fuels our world while tracking lethal solar storms.

programme.title: Strip The Cosmos S1 - "Alien Worlds"
programme.desc: A virtual scalpel dissects methane lakes and icy crusts to reveal hidden oceans and water-erupting volcanoes on distant moons.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Women with ADHD"
programme.desc: For decades, it was thought that ADHD primarily affected boys and men. Bue new research is revealing the stunning impact the disorder can have on women, leading to effective treatments for millions who may be suffering in silence.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Terry's Criminal Mind"
programme.desc: A murderer tries to kill his final victim as the car they are in slowly sinks to the bottom of a lake. The only way to save the victim is to rescue her as the car continues to sink.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Shark Go Boom!"
programme.desc: Here, Chief Brody hangs on to his sinking boat as a giant shark approaches him with a scuba tank lodged in its mouth. We construct a shark on a platform to test if you can hit the tank with an M1 Garand rifle while perched in a precarious position.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "The Good the Bad and Terry"
programme.desc: In this classic western, Clint Eastwood – aka “Blondie” – saves Eli Wallach from the hangman’s noose three separate times by shooting and severing the rope that he hangs from. We test the reality of these shots with the weapons that were used.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S1 - "Dying Hard"
programme.desc: John McLain (Bruce Willis) finds himself dangling from the side of a building. The only way to save himself is to shoot through the glass window and break through to safety.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Typhoo Tea and Fox's biscuits"
programme.desc: In search of the classic British pairing, tea and biscuits, Lord Prescott travels to Liverpool to visit the Typhoo tea factory, discovering the key to a perfectly brewed cup. Back in Yorkshire, he stops by the Fox’s biscuits factory, rounding off his journey with a truly British treat.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Ribena and Tyrells"
programme.desc: Taking a nostalgic journey to rediscover two of his childhood favourites, Lord Prescott visits the Ribena factory to see how their famous blackcurrant squash is made, using 90% of the UK's blackcurrant crop. In Herefordshire, he explores the Tyrrells crisp factory to learn how a small farm-based business turns homegrown potatoes into gourmet crisps.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Whitaker's Chocolates and Heck! Sausages"
programme.desc: Lord Prescott visits Whitaker’s chocolate factory to explore large-scale chocolate making, from factory lines to expert tasting and the company’s rich history. He then heads to HECK! Sausages in North Yorkshire, where he attempts to create his own custom recipe—the Hull banger.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Wensleydale Cheese and Mowbray Pork Pies"
programme.desc: At the Wensleydale Creamery, Lord Prescott joins master cheesemakers to follow the production of the famous Yorkshire Wensleydale cheese, learning the art of cheese-tasting along the way. His next stop is Mowbray Pork Pies, where he experiences the high-speed world of pie production.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Taking out the Trash"
programme.desc: Dave faces a tricky residential lift, J.P. races between last-minute jobs, and Brad and Nathan Moore help a family’s dream come true.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Bridging the Gap"
programme.desc: Nathan battles strong winds on a big roofing job, Dave handles an easy lift, J.P. moves a hot tub, and Dan faces confusion on a bridge build.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Special Delivery"

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "The Need for Speed"

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "New Orleans"

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "New York"
programme.desc: Dissecting New York's stone and steel, CGI reveals the inflatable subway plugs and bedrock foundations shielding the city from Atlantic superstorms.

programme.title: Strip The City S2 - "Paris"

On the other side, Pune United are fighting for survival, desperately needing a win after finally breaking their season-long drought earlier in the day. Witness intense matchups as tactical veterans like Trang Huynh and Max Mansoor face off against Pune's resilient stars, including the grit of Katie Morris and the power of William Sobeck. In a league where every rally counts toward the "Band of Honor," these athletes must battle both their opponents and the relentless 15-minute clock in a masterclass of professional pickleball.

Witness the technical mastery of Rika Fujiwara as she faces off against Alejandra Lopez in a high-stakes women’s singles match that sets the tone for the entire championship. The intensity reaches a fever pitch during a mixed doubles "masterclass" featuring Max Mansoor and Trang Huynh, which commentators hailed as the potential "rally of the season". With the "Band of Honor" and the ultimate league trophy on the line, every strategic "Pickle Play" and nerve-wracking volley contributes to an atmosphere so electric the crowd and commentators alike are left "going berserk".

programme.desc: Competitors need to hold their own in King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals? A winner is decided by the pit in this week’s final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The first heat of the second Revival Series begins. Robots return from previous series to take on the daring newcomers and each other. Competitors get bullied and thrown around the ring as they desperately try to scrape a place in the finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A tentative start to the second heat ends in carnage as the house robots and competitors go all out to qualify. Shunt delivers the final blow for one contestant.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The third heat shows devastating weapons put into action, being on the receiving end of these could mean elimination for an unlucky competitor. The house robots take on cleaning duties as they remove immobilised robots from the arena floor.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One competitor draws first blood only seconds into the first round. After suffering severe damage at the hands of another competitor, one robots chance at the finals may be lost.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last chance for combatants to fight for a place in the Grand Final. With the newcomers outnumbering the veterans, will the first timers make up for their lack of experience?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This episode, a new Robot Wars champion will emerge! Sparks and scraps are sure to fly in this explosive series finale. Winners will have to make it through the four-way melees and head-to-head battles to be able to prove themselves in the final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Newcomers, veterans and a recent President enter the fray in this first Heat of the series. Competitors are eliminated left, right and centre and only the strongest will survive to compete in the finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: A veteran only heat features the current reigning Champions, Carbide. Will Carbide’s streak be brought to an end by the other robots, more experienced and eager than ever?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Even the judges aren’t safe as two robots collide, sending shrapnel through the bullet-resistant shields around the arena. Two very different styles of robot meet in the finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: One newcomer stares down seven veterans, will their induction into the arena be successful, or will their inexperience find them in the pit? One robot will have a second chance to qualify in the Redemption Round.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The final heat features only veterans, here for an opportunity to make up for their mistakes in the previous tournaments. Only one competitor will make it into the Grand Finals, and the others must suffer defeat, again.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: After lengthy repairs and inspirational pep talks, the qualifiers prepare to fight for the title. A 10-way Robot Rumble will give the victor a spot in the Grand Finals, alongside the heat winners.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Six robots come to the arena to try and best the challenges that await, including Skittles, where they must act as an autonomous bowling ball to knock over as many barrels as they can, whilst trying to avoid the house robots.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors have a chance to go head-to-head with a house robot in a test of strength and strategy in this week’s trial, tug of war. Winners progress to the next round, losers take a face first dive into the pit.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: This week’s trial takes the competitors back in time to medieval England, where they will joust against an unyielding house robot in hopes of winning a chance at the crown. The house robots team up to take down an unlucky competitor in the arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Football returns to the arena in this week’s trial, complete with ferocious tackles, flamethrowers and own goals. In the semi-final, three of the house robots turn the arena into a barbeque.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors need to hold their own in King of the Castle, where they must defend a circle in the arena against the unforgiving house robots. How many will survive to make it to the semi-finals? A winner is decided by the pit in this week’s final.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: House robot, Shunt goes head-to-head with the competitors. It’s his job to remove the competitors from the ring by any means necessary in this week’s trial, Sumo. Will Shunt do the house robots proud, or will the competitors give him the slip?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The gauntlet has a menacing addition, The Sentinel. Will the new robot prove to be a real obstacle, or an easy route to be exploited? The Skittles trial returns to the arena, but one competitor wants to take down more than just barrels.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Football returns this week in the trial. New competitors enter the arena with high hopes of securing a place in the finals. The house robots show no mercy in the Gauntlet.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Matilda’s tusks get put to good use against the competitors as jousting returns to the arena. Two competitors form a rivalry after a memorable battle in the semi-finals.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Matilda takes centre stage again, as she attempts to pull as many competitors into the pit as possible in another tug of war. How will the competitors fair against the hazards of the arena and the merciless house robots?

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Competitors are once again tasked with defending their land in King of the Castle, will they defend their reign or be overthrown by the house robots? An even match in the semi-finals causes the house robots to forcefully decide a winner.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: Dead Metal takes to the ring to stop any competitors from progressing to the stage of the competition.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: First of the two Semi-Finals to determine which two of the six heat winners will progress to The Second Wars Grand Finals. The house robots are showing no mercy in the gauntlet and the competitors test their accuracy in this week’s trial, Pinball.

programme.title: Robot Wars
programme.desc: The last Semi-Final, competitors will once again battle the house robots in Pinball, evade them in the gauntlet and use them to destroy other competitors in the arena.

programme.title: Robot Wars
